Theme

Church life · Conversation, family & daily routines

Christ is risen! phrase

also He is risen indeed, Truly he is risen, Easter greeting, Christ is risen

our formation

Vulg. Lc. 24.34

Chrīstus surrēxit! — Vērē surrēxit!

Christ is risen! — He is risen indeed!

The Easter greeting of the Greek and Slavonic churches, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη — Ἀληθῶς ἀνέστη, given and answered from Easter night to the Ascension, put into the Latin of the Gospel: surrēxit Dominus vērē.

Examples

  • surrēxit Dominus vērē

    the Lord is risen indeedVulg. Lc. 24.34

Other words

  • Surrēxit Dominus vērē. — The Lord is risen indeed.

    also used · late Latin · Vulg. Lc. 24.34

    The disciples’ news to the two from Emmaus, the root of the greeting.

See also Easter, alleluia, Merry Christmas!.

SourcesLewis & Short: surgo · Lewis & Short: vere
